title: Ride-hailing surge pricing: cached multipliers that outlive their TTL
name: Surge multiplier cache

questions.prompt: After the stadium emptied last night, riders downtown were still quoted 3x fares an hour later, although driver supply had recovered within minutes. Quiet zones update fine. Separately, after a two-minute demand-feed outage, the busiest zones showed no surge at all for the rest of the evening. Fix the TtlCache in surge/ttlCache.ts so the tests pass, keeping the least-recently-used eviction.
